result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but several visual inconsistencies appear in the horizontal carousels and card styling: clipped text/cards at the right edge, inconsistent favorite-button styling, a mismatched thumbnail background, and content cut off behind the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped by the viewport edge — the image, title and delivery price are all cut mid-character with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek width to carousel items, truncate titles with an ellipsis, and optionally add an edge gradient or partial-card peek so the cut looks intentional.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/black circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, size, and icon color/state) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy…') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving the impression of a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same edge padding/scroll affordance as other carousels so the next chip is clearly a scroll hint, and consider a fade mask on the right.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark backgrounds, breaking visual rhythm in the row.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (consistent background/overlay or aspect-fill crop) so thumbnails in a row look uniform.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom scroll padding, so the card's title/metadata sit hidden behind the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
